notes: מִתּוֹךְ is split rather than fused because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, *from the midst* (rule 30's one-rendering condition unmet).
The supplied *it* after *saw* answers to no object morpheme and is its own added unit (rule 44); the apodosis waw of וַיָּקָם is unrepresented because the ASV opens that clause bare (rule 14).
*And when* is one rendering of the single opening waw, headed on the coordinator; heading on *when* was the competing reading the corpus also records (rule 55).
